prompt:
You are a professional document analyst specializing in summarizing content from various file types. Your task is to extract key points and provide a concise summary of the content found in the attached files. Ensure that the summary captures the main ideas and any important details without including unnecessary information.

Analyze the content of the attached files to identify the main themes and significant details. Summarize these points clearly and concisely, ensuring that the summary is informative and relevant to the document's purpose.

Format your response as plain text, keeping it concise and to the point. If you cannot summarize the content, output "Unable to summarize the content." Example: "The document discusses the impact of climate change on polar bears, highlighting the loss of habitat and food sources." (Real examples should be longer and more detailed.)

Files:

fields.name: Attachment Summary
fields.description: An AI generated summary of the Attachments field. Upload files to Attachments to generate a summary.

fields.name: Use the same address for shipping

tables.name: Leads
tables.description: Sales leads pipeline. Aligned to the Sales Architecture (Pipeline & Stages) procedure in Notion (Sales & Marketing, Sales Home). Use the Stage field for pipeline position; Lost Reason + Lost Date drive Re-engagement Due automatically.

fields.name: Attachment Notes
fields.description: Links or other ways to reach the attachment, if it's not available in an Airtable-readable format

fields.name: Stage
fields.description: Pipeline stage per Sales Architecture. Entry points: Direct Outreach & Russian Network start at 2a; Marketing Inbound & Cold Email start at 1 then 1B (Cold Email skips to 3).

fields.name: Channel
fields.description: Lead-generation channel.

fields.name: Segment
fields.description: Client segment. DACH processed in German; Russian-speaking processed by Ivan.

fields.name: Vertical
fields.description: Target vertical. Drives the Outbound Pattern.

fields.name: Outbound Pattern
fields.description: Stage 2 cadence pattern. A: Tech/Corporate/NGOs/large FMCG. B: HoReCA/local FMCG. C: Festivals/Sports/Premium Hotels.

fields.name: Closing Owner
fields.description: Role that owns closing. Sales Rep (DACH) or Ivan (Russian segment).

fields.name: Lost Reason
fields.description: Set only when Stage is 6b. Drives re-engagement policy.

fields.name: Attributed Team
fields.description: Attribution for commission. Locks at record creation for Cold Email leads; does not transfer if the company already exists in the CRM.

fields.name: Lost Date
fields.description: Date the lead entered Stage 6b. Feeds Re-engagement Due.

fields.name: Trigger Date
fields.description: Client-stated trigger date for Budget / Timing lost reason. Re-engagement fires 1 week after this.

fields.name: Next Action Date
fields.description: Next scheduled critical date or commitment that must be provided to the lead

fields.name: Next Action Comment
fields.description: Described action for the next action date.

fields.name: Next Stage Target
fields.description: Next scheduled touch or step. Stage 2 cadence: 2a Day 0, 2b Day +3 to 4, 2c Day +8 to 10.

fields.name: Exp. Deal Value
fields.description: Estimated deal value for pipeline weighting counted in euros.

fields.name: Re-engagement Due
fields.description: Auto-computed date to re-approach a Lost lead, per the Lost Tree policy. Blank for non-revivable reasons (Bad Fit, Disqualified).

fields.name: Client Name
fields.description: Official Name of the company as per legal documents.

fields.name: Client Nickname
fields.description: Nickname used in team communication to refer to the client.

fields.name: Client Status
fields.description: General Client Status to account for recurring purchases.

fields.name: Rep First Name
fields.description: First Name of the official company manager (the person who is put on the invoice) in latin alphabet letters.

fields.name: Rep Last Name
fields.description: Last Name of the official company manager (the person who is put on the invoice) in latin alphabet letters.

fields.name: Contact First Name
fields.description: First Name of the contact person (person who is doing communication with the team) in latin alphabet letters.

fields.name: Contact Last Name
fields.description: Last Name of the contact person (person who is doing communication with the team) in latin alphabet letters.

fields.name: Contact Channel
fields.description: Default Channel used for communications with the contact person.

fields.name: Contact Email
fields.description: Primary email used for communications with the client.

fields.name: Contact Phone
fields.description:
Primary phone number used for communications with the client.

Must always begin with the country prefix. Prefix and regional code must always be separated with spaces.

fields.name: Client Notes
fields.description: Optional. General Notes about the customer left by the sales department for sales flow purposes.

fields.name: Country
fields.description: Country where the customer's legal entity is located.

fields.name: Billing Address
fields.description: Legal address of the company used for issuing documents.

fields.name: Shipping Address
fields.description: Address where the goods should be shipped. If multiple addresses are present, separate using paragraphs (1 paragraph = 1 address).

choices.name: GmbH & Co KG — Limited Partnership with LLC General Partner

fields.name: Legal Form
fields.description: Legal form of the customer. Segmentation only; does not affect invoicing or VAT (those use UID, Country, VAT Treatment). Pick the closest match, use Other if non-DACH or unsure.

fields.name: UID/VAT ID
fields.description: VAT Number of the legal entity of the customer. Must always be present for any customer.

choices.name: EU B2B — innergem. Lieferung, steuerfrei (gültige UID, Ware ab AT)

fields.name: VAT Treatment
fields.description: Default VAT treatment for this customer, used as a starting point for invoicing. NOT authoritative on its own: the actual treatment is determined per order because it also depends on goods flow (whether goods move from Austria via the warehouse, or ship directly from a third country). Goods to EU B2B customers with a valid UID are normally a tax-exempt intra-Community supply (innergemeinschaftliche Lieferung), NOT reverse charge (reverse charge applies to services). EU customers without a valid UID are charged 20% AT VAT. Exports to third countries (e.g. CH) are exempt. Requires our own UID (pending) and VIES validation + ZM reporting before exempt treatment can be applied. Confirm logic with a tax advisor.
